description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410001 and other land settlements.
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
